stt: Ask HN: Any interesting books you have read lately?
Ask HN: Any interesting books you have read lately?
x: "The Chip", second edition.  Starts with the invention of the vacuum tube, ends with the US-China chip war.  In between, you learn that the first semiconductors were hand-make, using a clay mud on bulk substrate to protect areas to be etched.  Fair warning, he leaves out as much interesting material as he left in.
